entities.name: Martín Conde
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Martín Alejo Conde is an Argentine beach volleyball player who won the world title at the 2001 Beach Volleyball World Championships in Klagenfurt, Austria, partnering with Mariano Baracetti. He represented his native country at four consecutive Summer Olympics, starting in 1996.
